ruleDefinitions.name: Always Install Elevated Windows Installer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows Installer service (msiexec.exe) trying to install MSI packages with SYSTEM privilege

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*msi.*")) AND process_path = RGX("tmp$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384"))) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services\.exe" OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\\\system32\\\\msiexec\\\.exe\\ \\/V$") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\\\system32\\\\msiexec\\\.exe\\ \\/V$")) OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Sophos\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Avira\\\\") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Avast\\ Software\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Avast\\ Software\\\\")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Update\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Google\\\\Update\\\\")))
